 6th Match, Dunedin Sat 31 Oct Otago Volts Central Districts Sat 31 Oct, 21:30 GMT 
 The Ford Trophy 2026-27 continues on October 30 with Northern Districts vs Auckland Aces, Wellington Firebirds vs Canterbury Kings and Otago Volts vs Central Districts. Check out our match predictions for all three fixtures at Bay Oval, Basin Reserve and University Oval.
 Match Prediction - Northern Districts Men v Auckland Aces 
 LIVE SCORES - 4th Match - Northern Districts vs Auckland Aces (Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui) 
 Current Form Northern Districts: 
 Northern Districts are currently placed at the 1st position on points table with 1 win to their credit. They have 4 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Northern Districts in The Ford Trophy 2026-27 is Robert O Donnell with 145 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Northern Districts in The Ford Trophy 2026-27 is Joshua Brown with 3 scalps under his belt.
 Northern Districts have won their previous match against Central Districts by a big margin of 62 runs.
 Northern Districts batted first and they posted a total of 403 for 6 in 50 overs. Aryan Mann and Joe Carter got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Mike Schlanders and Robert O Donnell played really well. Schlanders made 97 runs while Donnell smashed 145 runs in only 102 deliveries, collecting 17 fours and 7 sixes. Brett Hampton, Xavier Bell and Katene Clarke also contributed quite well and helped Northern Districts get to a tall total of 403 in 50 overs of play.
 During the chase, Central Districts lost a couple of early wickets and looked to be in deep waters. Josh Clarkson and Sam Cassidy played to their potential and scored 74 and 137 runs respectively to light up hopes for a successful chase. However, both of them got out at a wrong time. Wickets kept falling in regular succession and Central Districts were eventually bowled out for 341, losing the match by 62 runs.
 Current Form Auckland Aces: 
 Auckland Aces are currently placed at the 2nd position on points table with 1 win to their credit. They have 4 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Auckland Aces in The Ford Trophy 2026-27 is Sean Solia with 120 runs to his name .
 The top wicket taker for Auckland Aces in The Ford Trophy 2026-27 is Adithya Ashok with 3 scalps under his belt.
 Auckland Aces have won their previous match against Canterbury Kings by 33 runs (DLS method).
 Auckland Aces batted first and they posted a total of 361 for 5 in 50 overs. Sean Solia and Dale Phillips played really well at the top. Solia made 120 runs while Dale Phillips scored 112 runs to get Auckland Aces off to a great start. Cam Fletcher also played a nice cameo of 58 runs in only 43 balls. On the back of such brilliant batting knocks, Auckland Aces managed to reach a total of 361 in 50 overs of play.
 During the chase, Canterbury Kings lost the key wickets of Henry Nicholls, Scott Janet and Tom Latham quite early. After their dismissals, Chad Bowes and Leo Carter played well. Bowes made 154 runs off 106 balls while Carter scored 37 runs. After Cater got out, Bowes felt very lonely and found it tough to navigate through the tough waters alone. He was dismissed by Sean Solia in the 37th over and things started going downhill from there onwards for Canterbury Kings. Adithya Ashok picked up 3 wickets for 64 runs and helped bowl Canterbury Kings out for 311, as Auckland Aces won the game by 33 runs (DLS method).

Jesse Tashkoff and Tom Blundell tried to revive the innings with knocks of 45 and 25 runs respectively but both of them threw it away at a wrong time.
